summary: Iteration 68 — Frontend testing of the P0 Multi-Part per-item state preservation fix and the 6 acceptance criteria from the review request. All flows PASS end-to-end. (1) Multi-Part BOM tab switching preserves per-component state (Item Description, Width, Length) across 3 back-and-forth cycles — verified on a fresh MP quote with 2 components (PartA 40×30 vs PartB 20×15) and on the pre-existing 4-component IP Retail Pkg & Display quote (40in Wrap 26×44.5, 48in Wrap 25×51.5, Bottom Tray 48.75×54.5, Tear Out Case 24.25×68.5). (2) Save + reload of new MP quote SA-260731-201553 preserves both components' data correctly (PartA 40/30 and PartB 20/15 read back). (3) Simple quote flow priced correctly: 40×30 · qty 500 → Sell/EA $8.91 · Total $4,455.42 · GM 26.7% · Cost Buildup right rail populated (Material $1,281.93, Print $1,578.13, Cutting $355.90, Total Direct $3,265.96). (4) Pricing Strategy tile-basis-gm is active by default on new Simple quote (bg rgba(168,85,247,0.133), color rgb(168,85,247)) while tile-basis-msf inactive. (5) Copy from Load modal on team-owned SAVED quote RA-260615-082017 (Riley, Ashley) opens a new draft with toast 'Copied RA-260615-082017 → new draft (RA-260615-082017-COPY)' — no errors. (6) Test flag toggled and toolbar Report → xlsx download succeeded (spot-testing-report-2026-07-31.xlsx, 5964 bytes, HTTP 200).

ui_bugs.issue: After Copy action, the newly-opened draft displays est# 'RA-260615-082017' in the estimate-# input and toolbar-est-num while the success toast says the new draft est# is 'RA-260615-082017-COPY'. Cosmetic mismatch — the '-COPY' suffix is not visible in the header/input on the newly opened tab. Also the toast fires twice (duplicate). No functional error; a new draft is created. Review request expected the '-COPY' suffix to be visible.

issues: The pill container ([data-testid=bom-item-N]) is not the clickable region for activating a component; clicking the pill wrapper often lands on the nested Manufactured/Purchased/Fulfillment select instead of switching the active component. The actual activation target is the inner [data-testid=bom-item-desc-N] span. Consider making the whole pill click-to-activate (with the type select as a stopPropagation child) for better ergonomics and easier automation. Also emit a data-active attribute on the active pill for a11y/testing.

frontend: Login as admin@standardprinting.com via JWT fallback → OK, SPOT shell + toolbar rendered with all data-testids present (toolbar-save, toolbar-load, toolbar-test-flag, toolbar-test-report, toolbar-toggle-mp).

Fresh Simple quote (input-qty-0=500, input-one-up-w=40, input-one-up-l=30) → Quote Table rendered 1 SEL row @ $8.91 / $1,189.46 GM$ / $4,455.42 Total; Cost Buildup summary + Economics right rail populated; PRICING STRATEGY pill 'GM%'; tile-basis-gm active (purple bg/color) vs tile-basis-msf inactive.
Save Simple quote → est# SA-260731-200557 assigned; toolbar-status shows 'Saved'.

Fresh Multi-Part quote via tile-quote-multipart → BOM Builder modal auto-opened (dismissed via Escape), then +Component×2 created bom-item-0 and bom-item-1. Set comp0=(PartA/40/30) and comp1=(PartB/20/15). 3× back-and-forth using [data-testid=bom-item-desc-N] click → each read returned the correct per-component values (no bleed).
Saved MP quote SA-260731-201553 → reload via Load → both components read PartA/40/30 and PartB/20/15 (persistence verified).

Pre-existing 4-component MP quote SA-260731-200557 (IP Retail Pkg & Display · Report Test) → cycling comp0..3 via bom-item-desc-N returns correct per-component values (40in Wrap 26×44.5 · 48in Wrap 25×51.5 · Bottom Tray 48.75×54.5 · Tear Out Case 24.25×68.5). Round-trip back to comp0 also preserved.
Test flag (toolbar-test-flag) checked → true; toolbar-test-report clicked → download event fired, spot-testing-report-2026-07-31.xlsx saved to /tmp (5964 bytes).

Load modal → Saved tab → Team scope → Copy action on RA-260615-082017 (owner Riley, Ashley) → success toast 'Copied RA-260615-082017 → new draft (RA-260615-082017-COPY)', new tab opened with quote data (Jamestown Container Corp. - Falconer · Luva Bella Winery · 3 components · qty 2352), no error messages in DOM.

action_items: MINOR: Investigate why the newly-opened draft after Copy shows the ORIGINAL est# 'RA-260615-082017' in [data-testid=input-est-num] and toolbar rather than the '-COPY'-suffixed est# advertised in the toast. Confirm whether backend copy_quote actually persists the '-COPY' suffix and whether the frontend is loading the wrong tab or stripping the suffix on display.

MINOR: The 'Copied ... → new draft (...-COPY)' toast fires twice for a single Copy click (React StrictMode double-invoke or two state paths both firing addToast). Debounce or move toast emit outside the effect.

UX: Make the entire BOM pill [data-testid=bom-item-N] click-to-activate the component (currently only [data-testid=bom-item-desc-N] activates; clicking the pill wrapper triggers the nested type select). Also add data-active='true' on the pill and Item Setup label to help e2e tests and screen readers.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/lib/mpSchema.js gatherItemState(state, prev) non-destructive merge appears to work correctly — verified by full round-trip on both fresh (2-comp) and pre-existing (4-comp) MP quotes; no cross-component bleed observed on widths/lengths/description after 3 cycles and after save+reload.

frontend/src/lib/defaults.js DEFAULT_STATE.pricingBasis='Gross Margin %' verified: tile-basis-gm is the active tile on a brand-new Simple quote (computed style purple ~rgb(168,85,247)), Pricing Strategy summary pill reads 'GM%'.

backend/routes/quotes.py copy_quote — verified via UI Copy action (toast confirmed '-COPY' suffix generated). However the loaded copy tab in the UI shows the original est# without the '-COPY' suffix; suggest either (a) update est-num input on load to reflect the persisted value from the response, or (b) confirm the new draft is what the user is looking at (may currently be showing the source doc's est-num inadvertently).

BOM strip UX: [data-testid=bom-item-N] pill has a nested <select data-testid=bom-item-type-N> that intercepts clicks in most of the pill area — activation requires clicking the small inner label span. Consider restructuring so the pill's onClick sets the active index and the select uses stopPropagation. This will also fix the confusing dropdown-opens-when-I-meant-to-switch behavior seen during automation.

React style-mixing console warnings 'Updating a style property during rerender' fire several times per navigation (shorthand vs individual style keys). Non-blocking but noisy — worth cleaning up in the pill/tab components.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 acceptance criteria PASS; 1 cosmetic + 1 UX finding)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-Part per-item state preservation IS working. IMPORTANT — in the current DOM the ACTIVATION click target for a BOM component is the inner [data-testid=bom-item-desc-N] span, NOT the outer [data-testid=bom-item-N] pill (the pill contains a nested type select which usually swallows the click). If you write scripts against bom-item-N you'll observe false 'bleed' failures because the active component never actually changes. Use bom-item-desc-N for tab-switch tests. Also, on a fresh Multi-Part toggle, the BOM Builder modal auto-opens for empty BOMs — dismiss with Escape before calling bom-add-btn. Copy action only appears on Saved Quotes owned by OTHER users (Team scope + non-'You' owner); own SAVED rows only show Open + delete.
rca of the issue: N/A — the fix delivered in this session (mpSchema.gatherItemState(state, prev) non-destructive merge + applyItemStateTo clearing per-item freight caches + QuoteContext gatherItemState call-sites passing items[oldIdx]?.state) is verified end-to-end on both freshly-built 2-component MP quotes and on the pre-existing 4-component IP Retail Pkg & Display MP quote. Tab switching, saving, and reloading all preserve per-component Item Description, Width, and Length exactly as entered — no leakage from the last-active component. tile-basis-gm default active state and Report/Test-flag xlsx download and Copy action also work.
